# Bats Club

> Private collector archive and marketplace for rare vintage Japanese
> anime figures from the 1990s-2000s. Every listing is a real, physical
> piece from one private collection, sold directly — not a crowd-sourced
> community catalog or encyclopedia.

## Sections
- [Archive](https://batsclub.com/archive): full browsable catalog by
  series, character, manufacturer, year
- [Shop](https://batsclub.com/shop): active for-sale listings with
  condition, price, worldwide shipping
- [Articles](https://batsclub.com/articles): collector spotlights and
  figure guides

## Known collections
- Weekly Dearest My Brother (Shuukan Watashi no Oniichan)
- To Heart 2
- Bakemonogatari / Monogatari series (incl. Shinobu Oshino)
- Yosuga no Sora (incl. Kokonoe Rin)
- Neon Genesis Evangelion (incl. Rei Ayanami)
- Ghost in the Shell

## Notes
- Available in English, Russian (/ru), and Japanese (/jp) - series and
  character names are searched in both English and original Japanese
  (romaji) form
- Each figure page lists character, series, manufacturer, scale, year,
  material, and condition
- Guest checkout available - no account required to buy
